image_description: The image displays three dogs standing on a grassy field. In the foreground, there is a reddish-brown dog with a short coat and a visible ridge along its spine, consistent with a Rhodesian Ridgeback. To the right stands a large tan dog with a black muzzle, resembling a Great Dane. In the background left, there is a large white and brown spotted dog, appearing to be a Saint Bernard.

The visible forelegs and hindlegs appear straight with good bone structure and muscle definition. No bowing or structural deformities are evident.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible, thicker at the root and tapering towards the tip. It is held out with a slight upward curve, typical of the breed when alert.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gait is free and powerful with strong drive.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a static photograph; gait (movement dynamics) cannot be evaluated from a still pose.
